name: Typestate Machine Transitions
description: Encodes protocol, pipeline, and hardware lifecycle states into zero-sized phantom type parameters at compile time, eliminating runtime state validation checks.
recommendations: Encode operational phases into generic type parameters using core::marker::PhantomData.
Implement state transitions by consuming self by-value (pub fn advance(self) -> Task<NextState>) to prevent use-after-transition bugs.
Eliminate runtime boolean state flags (e.g., is_initialized, is_valid) in favor of static compiler-enforced typestates.
